description: This is a Java test class for the BaseUnvoidHandler, which tests unvoiding (restoring) functionality for objects implementing the Voidable interface within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: BaseUnvoidHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of BaseUnvoidHandler's unvoiding methods.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheVoidedBit
methods.description: Tests that the handle method unsets the 'voided' flag on a Voidable object.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheVoider
methods.description: Tests that the handle method unsets the 'voidedBy' user on a Voidable object.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheDateVoided
methods.description: Tests that the handle method clears the 'dateVoided' field on a Voidable object.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheVoidReason
methods.description: Tests that the handle method clears the 'voidReason' on a Voidable object.

methods.name: handle_shouldOnlyActOnAlreadyVoidedObjects
methods.description: Ensures handle method does not modify an object that is not voided.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotActOnObjectsWithADifferentDateVoided
methods.description: Checks that handle does not clear voided status if the dateVoided is different.
